embeddingModels.name: Gemini Embedding 2
embeddingModels.description: Google's current embedding model (May 2026), 3072 dimensions, 8K context. Verified byte-identical between OpenRouter and Google's native API, on both bare and prefixed input -- OpenRouter passes it through faithfully. Note it dropped task_type: its semantic-similarity mode lives in a text prefix, not in input_type, which it ignores.
embeddingModels.inputTypeNote: input_type does NOT reach this model: semantic_similarity returns the byte-identical vector to sending nothing, which means the parameter is ignored, not that the default is already semantic. Its real semantic-similarity mechanism is a TEXT PREFIX on the canonical document (task: sentence similarity | query: ...), measured at cosine 0.811 from the bare text. That prefix is not yet supported here, so this model currently embeds in its generic default space.

embeddingModels.name: Gemini Embedding 001
embeddingModels.description: Previous-generation Google embedding model, 3072 dimensions. Through OpenRouter its default output is the RETRIEVAL space: default, search_query and search_document all return the identical vector, and only input_type: semantic_similarity differs (measured cosine 0.867 on the same text). Set the retrieval mode explicitly for item-to-item work.
embeddingModels.inputTypeNote: Its default output is the RETRIEVAL space. Measured through OpenRouter, default, search_query and search_document all return the identical vector, and only semantic_similarity differs (cosine 0.867 on the same text). Recommendations compare films against other films and build a taste vector by averaging them, so this needs the symmetric space set explicitly.

embeddingModels.name: Qwen3 Embedding 8B
embeddingModels.description: Open-weights embedder, 4096 dimensions, 32K context. Instruction-aware, but its documented recipe puts the instruction on the QUERY side against bare documents -- there is no official symmetric recipe, so it does not take a retrieval mode here. OpenRouter routes it across several upstream providers unless routing is pinned.
embeddingModels.inputTypeNote: Takes no mode. Qwen is instruction-aware, but its documented recipe puts the instruction on the QUERY against bare documents, and this recommender has no text query -- the query is a centroid of item vectors. Prefixing every document identically is not an official Qwen form.
